title: add_task
prompt: Write add_task(tasks, text) that APPENDS {"text": text, "done": False} to a copy of tasks and returns the new list. Do not mutate the input list.

tests.name: adds without mutating
tests.code:
original = []
result = add_task(original, "buy milk")
assert result == [{"text": "buy milk", "done": False}], f"got {result}"
assert original == [], "input list must NOT be mutated"
assert add_task(result, "walk dog")[-1]["text"] == "walk dog", "chains on the result"
tests.hint: new = list(tasks); new.append({...}); return new — or tasks + [item].
